judge: interface-craft-reviewer (Opus), blind to the HTML — graded on rendered full-page PNGs only

screens.note: Monday correctly EXCLUDED from the 24h total because 'by arrangement' is uncountable — the one place this screen could have lied and did not.
Every hold countdown reconciles to the minute against the masthead clock; the hold bar is measured (96% fill for 46h12m of 48h), not decorative.

Derivation is disclosed in full and the arithmetic reconciles (24h open, 4h booked, 20h free). Fixed a real contradiction the honesty checks do not cover: the printed rule says the Foundations course repeats every Tuesday from 4 Aug, but Tue 11 Aug AND Tue 1 Sep carried no block. Both added; derived course time sits outside the 10:00-16:00 pattern so the booked tally is correctly unchanged.

CRAFT REGEN CLEARED. Prior grade failed on atmosphere 3 ("a palette is not a place") — zero imagery in 3047px. One art-directed photograph of her studio was cut into the masthead as a clearing; atmosphere 3 -> 6, overall 6 -> 7. A fresh judge re-verified every figure independently (STALE 07:40 + 1h34m = the 09:14 masthead clock) and confirmed all five states survived at full standard, state-completeness still 10. Also fixed: the screen pointed at a "Bookings" destination absent from its own nav rail.
Reference counts 3/1/0/2 reconcile with the headline claim. Regen fixed a false sort label (rows were not most-recent-first) and made the zero-reference row visually distinct from the others.
Pending count reconciles field-by-field with the marked sections plus one named off-page settings change; 4 showing + 1 hidden + 2 always-on = 7.
9 ready + 2 needing alt text + 1 processing = 12, verified tile by tile against every restatement of the count.

Regen corrected three wrong weekdays on the sent records (28 Jul 2026 is a Tuesday, 1 Jul and 3 Jun are Wednesdays), independently verified against a real calendar. The screen's whole argument is that these records are permanent and trustworthy.

HONESTY REGEN CLEARED. The prior grade (overall 4) found the masthead claiming "9 on sale" against 8 published + 1 hidden rows. Fixed to "8 on sale · 1 hidden"; a fresh judge independently re-derived every count from the rows (8+1, ALL·9 = 3+3+3, capacity bar 70% against 7-of-10, overflow 9+25=34) and confirmed clean.
The load-bearing claim holds in the pixels: no figure anywhere sums confirmed + pending, and the string '100' does not appear.
Takes the correct position in its headline ('Nothing is booked yet.') and never lets the hold pass as a booking.
No payment field anywhere, so 'nothing is charged until she confirms' matches what the surface actually does.
File facts read as recorded rather than decorative, and sit before the control so the reader knows what they are accepting.
Cadence is hedged to something a solo practitioner can actually keep, and the guide is handed over on the page rather than promised as a future email.
Says 'sent', never 'delivered'; the address-unknown state admits the page cannot tell which address was entered.
States removal as completed, offers return without guilt, never reopens the decision.
